hypothesis.statement: Render and evidence counts cannot detect subtle lip, eyelid, cheek, neck or temporal deformation failures without exact frame-level geometry diagnostics.
hypothesis.action: Require eleven unit-bound diagnostics at all forty-five declared frames, validate finite values and thresholds, and reject missing, duplicate or self-inconsistent reports.
hypothesis.expectedResult: A complete zero-defect fixture passes while the current workspace remains pending until Unreal Editor emits real geometry samples.

decision: Keep the evaluator as a mandatory pre-G4 gate. Do not infer geometry success from videos or evidence counts alone.
nextEvidence: UE 5.6 frame sampler output containing all 495 finite unit-bound values plus matching 45-frame Go renders
